notes.title: Our Brand New Game is Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Our Brand New Game is Coming to Steam! 🎉[/h2]
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that our brand new game has passed Steam store review! You can now find our game on Steam for preview, although it's not available for purchase yet.

Dice Dice Dice is a relaxed, turn-based casual game with a unique design style that offers an unparalleled gaming experience. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer, you'll find joy in this game!

We warmly invite you to join our community to stay updated on the latest news and updates about the game. Your feedback is crucial to us as it helps us continually improve the gaming experience.

Stay tuned for more details and the official release date! Thank you for your support and patience.

We warmly welcome you to embark on the journey of Dice Dice Dice! Let's explore this world full of surprises together!

[h2]🌟 Add Dice Dice Dice to your wishlist now to be the first to receive official release information! 🌟[/h2]
